links.outcome: Multimodal LLM top-1 diagnostic accuracy on misdiagnosed dermatology cases
links.effect: Multimodal Top-1 accuracy: Gemini 3 60.0% (18/30), ChatGPT-5.2 56.7% (17/30), Claude 4.5 Sonnet 33.3% (10/30); limited accuracy for malignant lesions using macro-images.
links.quote: Gemini 3 achieved the highest multimodal Top-1 accuracy (60.0% (18/30), followed by ChatGPT-5.2 at 56.7% (17/30) and Claude 4.5 Sonnet at 33.3% (10/30).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of multimodal LLMs on retrospective clinical dilemma cases to test diagnostic accuracy and human error replication without evaluating a deployment guardrail or organizational practice.
